title: Product Engineer, Compute Operations

snapshot.text:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DECISION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Automate the delivery of gigawatts. Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand.

 - Forward-deploy beside the experts. Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit.

 - Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last. Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Build the fleet health system: real-time telemetry and tiered healthchecks on every machine across Kubernetes and bare metal, rolled into one API the whole company trusts to answer "is this machine healthy," with alarms correlated into incidents that reach on-call with a drafted probable cause.

 - Turn repair and RMA into generated work: one tracked flow from failure detection through triage, parts, vendor return, and return to service, where failure thresholds route machines to repair automatically, each production engineer's shift todo list is generated for them, and time to return to service is a number the system reports.

 - Ship hardware qualification as software: burn-in, performance baselining, and new hardware validation composed into rack-level workflows, so bringing thousands of accelerators online is a repeatable run and every machine enters production with its acceptance evidence attached in the graph.

 - Run the facility on the same system as the fleet: the maintenance system for lockout tagout and work orders is live at one site and rolls out to two more, every asset register loads before the first external audit this fall, and the legacy datacenter inventory retires before the next building energizes. You own the asset model, the migration, and the day the old tools switch off.

 - Turn every runbook into a checked procedure: SOPs, training records, and technician qualifications become structured data the customer can audit, and site SLOs, deployment cycle time, and labor ramp report themselves on the dashboards a hyperscaler customer asked for. You work forward-deployed beside production engineers and facility operators, on site and on the rotation, and build what they use the next shift.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've shipped production code in Go, Python, or TypeScript, and you pick up whatever language the problem demands.

 - You've built real features on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-weight models), MCP servers, and agentic frameworks.

 - You work daily with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and you get agents doing useful work autonomously alongside you.

 - You identify problems, design the solution, and ship it without waiting for direction or approval.

 - You've moved fast under deadline while leaving foundations that other engineers extended after you moved on.

 - You've sat the on-call rotation or worked beside the people who do, and you've turned operational pain into systems that made the pager quieter.

 - Your product taste shows in what you've shipped: interfaces the engineers on the rotation call obvious, and workflows that match how the work actually happens.

 - Bonus: Production engineering or SRE on large GPU fleets. Hardware qualification or burn-in frameworks. BMC, Redfish, or IPMI tooling. CMMS, DCIM, or asset management systems. BMS/EPMS or SCADA. Prometheus and Grafana.
   
   Benefits:

 - Competitive total compensation package (cash + equity)

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - Retirement plan

 - Generous PTO policy



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Product Manager, Partner Ecosystem

snapshot.text:
This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
The Opportunity
Adyen’s Partner Ecosystem is one of our fastest-growing distribution channels, and a critical path to scalably bring the best of Adyen to merchants. Through partnerships with major commerce, POS, enterprise software, and cloud platforms (such as Adobe Commerce, Salesforce, Oracle, and SAP), Adyen powers billions of dollars in global transaction volume.
We need a Product Manager to bring a cohesive vision to how we approach the Partner Ecosystem – what does a successful Partner Ecosystem look like? What are the critical Partner journeys we need to unlock and optimize? What tooling, data, and interfaces do we need to enable success? We’ve gotten this far with groups of systems that have organically grown over time – now we need you to bring a vision that helps us scale to the next level.
Working with key commercial, marketing, go-to-market, and technical delivery stakeholders, you will identify systemic friction points across partner onboarding, integration certification, ecosystem observability, and day-to-day partner operations and integrations. You will build and scale internal applications, automation frameworks, and data platforms that empower our global teams to scale partner integrations effortlessly and reliably.
What You'll Do

Define the Product Vision & Roadmap: Own the end-to-end product strategy for internal partner tooling, developer infrastructure, and operational workflows. Translate complex cross-functional challenges into clear product roadmaps with measurable business outcomes.
Build High-Impact Internal Platforms: Design and deliver internal tools and services—such as integration health monitoring, automated regression and compliance testing suites, partner certification portals, and self-service analytics platforms.
Eliminate Operational Overhead: Work closely with Partner Solutions Engineering to identify manual, repetitive operational bottlenecks in partner onboarding and integration maintenance. Drive automation and self-service workflows that systematically grind down operational toil.
Pioneer AI & Intelligent Automation: Champion the adoption of intelligent agents, LLM-powered workflows, and automated triage systems to accelerate partner enablement, technical inquiries, and documentation discovery.
Enhance Ecosystem Observability: Partner with data and core engineering teams to establish single-source-of-truth observability across global partner integrations, empowering internal teams to monitor transaction health, payment method performance, and authorization optimization opportunities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the connective tissue bridging Partner Engineering, Commercial Partnerships, Core Product, Technical Support, and Compliance across our global offices (San Francisco, Amsterdam, Chicago, New York, and São Paulo).

Who You Are

Proven Product Ownership: 8+ years of product management experience, preferably leveraging tooling, developer platforms, technical workflows, or complex B2B/API products in high-growth software or fintech environments.
Technical Acumen: Strong technical foundation and fluency with modern software architecture, APIs, web technologies, and data pipelines. Comfortable having deep architectural discussions with senior engineers and solutions architects.
Data-Driven & Problem Solver: You excel at breaking down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder operational problems into structured, scalable solutions. You rely on qualitative user insights and quantitative telemetry to prioritize ruthlessly based on ROI.
User-Centric Empathy: High empathy for internal users. You listen intently to technical and operational teams to understand their daily friction and take pride in delivering software that makes your colleagues significantly more productive.
Autonomy & Bias for Action: You thrive in fast-paced environments where ownership is distributed. You don't wait for permission; you identify opportunities, build consensus, and drive initiatives to launch.
Collaborative Communicator: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of synthesizing technical complexity into concise narratives for executive leadership, engineering peers, and commercial counterparts across multiple time zones.
Formula Fit: You embrace the Adyen Formula—you value direct communication, team success over individual ego, long-term durable outcomes, and open collaboration.

Total rewards & compensation
The annual base salary range for this role is $169,000 - $246,000. Compensation is based on factors including qualifications, experience, and location. Total compensation package includes equity (RSUs), 401(k), health, dental, vision, and more.
In-office expectations
This role is based in our San Francisco office. We're an office-first company and expect employees to work in-office at least 3 days a week on average. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while also supporting flexibility.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen
We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen. 
If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply.
What’s next?
Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. If you have specific time constraints, please communicate them with your recruiter, and we’ll do our best to accommodate them where possible.
EEO statement
Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
San Francisco 
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

snapshot.descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will design, develop, and support scalable enterprise applications with a strong focus on backend engineering while contributing to modern React-based user interfaces. Our ideal candidate has strong experience building secure, cloud-native microservices, enjoys solving production challenges, and thrives in Agile teams.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, React, and SQL Server following modern software architecture principles.
  • Build and enhance secure RESTful APIs and microservices while ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, implement preventive measures, and collaborate with DevOps teams to improve application reliability.
  • Implement authentication and authorization using Keycloak (preferable) or similar tools like OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and JWT, ensuring enterprise-grade security.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, architects, and business stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle using Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, mentoring junior developers, and driving engineering best practices across the team.

Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)

  • 6 years of experience in software development using C#, ASP.NET Core/.NET Core, and enterprise application development.
  • Strong experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, RESTful API development, Microservices Architecture, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server.
  • Hands-on experience implementing authentication and authorization using Keycloak (preferable) or similar tools like JWT, OAuth2, and, OpenID Connect.
  • Good understanding of application architecture, dependency injection, middleware, API versioning, logging, exception handling, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

  • Hands-on experience with messaging technologies such as MQTT, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other event-driven architectures.

  • Prior experience mentoring developers, leading technical discussions, and contributing to architectural decisions.

title: Lead Design Builder

snapshot.text:
Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform.


THE ROLE

You own the marketplace surfaces where that decision happens — listing and submission, the offer moment, bidding and auction close, payout, the places where Alt asserts a price and asks someone to act on it. Design at Alt isn't a service function that receives requirements. It's the discipline that writes them.

The bar you're held to: every surface you own ships with a written problem frame, a metric instrumented before launch, a readout you ran yourself — and craft good enough that a user screenshots it and sends it to someone. One without the other doesn't count here. A beautiful screen that didn't move anything is a miss. A number that moved on a surface nobody wants to look at is a different kind of miss.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

 - The problem. You write the framing for your surfaces: who's hurting, the evidence, the number that says it's real, the metric that says it worked. AI-assisted, design-reviewed, never skipped. If nobody can state the problem in a sentence, it isn't ready to be solved.

 - The craft. How completely the solution solves the problem, all the way to delight. It runs the full arc: reading the problem so precisely that the solution feels obvious in hindsight, shaping the flow so the user never has to think about the tool. It takes a user from "this worked" to "I want to show someone." That's still made by a person with taste and reps. We can generate a hundred options in an hour; you're here because you can make one of them solve the problem so well it delights.

 - The solution space. Multiple real directions, converged against your surface's written bar. You'll pressure-test, extend, and validate with users — not pick the first thing that renders.

 - The experience decisions. When a thing appears, what it feels like in the user's actual state, what tone it takes, what gets removed to make room, and what it does to neighboring screens. On a platform where people wire five figures based on what a screen makes them feel, these decisions are the product.

 - The words. Copy is design here. The sentence that explains why an offer is what it is does more work than the layout around it. You write it.

 - Trust, specifically. How much confidence we assert, when we show uncertainty, what the platform states versus suggests. As more of what we show a user is model-generated, this becomes the highest-stakes surface in the company, and Design has sign-off on it.

 - The crafted base. The quality foundation your team iterates on, and its survival through implementation. You pair with engineers at ship time; built-versus-designed fidelity is yours.

 - Your metrics. Instrumented before launch. You run your own readouts and kill your own misses.

 - The research. Customer conversations every week, CX tickets and session replays mined as a habit, lightweight tests run by you, at the pace of the work. Your frames cite evidence because you went and got it.

 - The prototype. You build. Working prototypes in code, not click-throughs, are how ideas get evaluated here, because a thing you can touch settles an argument in an afternoon that a doc would run for two weeks.


HOW YOU'LL USE AI HERE:

We don't want to hear that you use Claude every day. Everyone does. We want to know what you've built with it. Concretely, in this role:

Get to a clickable prototype of a new flow in a day — real card data, simulated model output, testable interactions — so the team argues about a real thing instead of a doc

 - Write a Claude skill that holds your surface's written bar, so every frame gets checked against it before it reaches review, and the bar stops depending on who's in the room

 - Mine CX tickets and session replays at volume to find the pattern you'd never catch by hand — the phrasing that precedes an abandoned submission, the screen people revisit three times before they bail

 - Turn a customer call into a synthesis the team can act on the same afternoon, not a deck three weeks later

 - Generate and kill twenty directions before you commit to one, and be able to say what each one taught you

 - Put a prototype in front of actual high-value sellers and come to roadmap planning with behavioral data — "version B moved stated acceptance likelihood, here's the prototype, here's the number"

And have a view on the other side of it: where AI output is actively wrong for this work, and what you refuse to hand to a model. We ask.

If you've built agents, written skills or MCP servers, wired up connectors, or shipped internal tooling your team actually depends on — lead with that. Name the artifact, not the tool.


WHAT YOU BRING:

 - Relentless curiosity about users. This is the first bar. Not "I read the research" — you go and get it.

 - You've made ambiguity tractable, more than once. Not a UI problem with a brief attached: a genuinely open problem, where you had to decide what the problem even was before anyone could work on it. You can tell us how you structured the chaos, what you chose not to solve, and how you knew when you had clarity.

 - Articulation as part of your craft. You can state a problem so cleanly that the room aligns before a single mock exists, and defend a trade-off to an engineer, a founder, and a customer in their own languages. If we ask "what were you actually solving?" about your best work, the answer arrives in one sentence, not a walkthrough.

 - Influence without authority. You've changed what a company built through the quality of your reasoning: reframed a roadmap, killed a bad direction, gotten engineers to fight for your design's details.

 - Founding, first, or early designer experience — or you've built something of your own. You know what it costs to own an outcome end to end.

 - You've shipped things you conceived, not just executed from someone else's spec, and you can narrate the problem-framing behind your best work unprompted.

 - A portfolio organized around problems and outcomes, not screens. You talk about your work quantitatively: what moved, what you killed, what you learned.

 - You prototype in code, or in code-adjacent tools, as a thinking medium. AI is already how you work. You can name the last thing you built with Claude, Cursor, Lovable, v0, or Figma Make — and what it got wrong. We'll ask you to show us, so bring something real.

 - 

Bonus: marketplace or two-sided experience; high-consideration or financial products where trust was the conversion problem; consumer products with a passionate community; you collect, or you have a view on where this market is going.


HOW WE'LL INTERVIEW YOU

We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, and sell.  Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. For this role, pay attention to the submission, offer, and auction surfaces — those are the ones you'd own

1. Recruiter screen— 30 minutes The surfaces you own today and the metric you move. Why Alt. How AI actually shows up in your workflow. We'll answer your questions and talk comp.

2. Hiring manager with Vijay, Head of Design — 60 minutes, Google Meet. How you frame problems. Bring an open problem you had to define before anyone could work on it, and be ready on what you chose not to solve. Two or three pieces organized around problems and outcomes, not screens. Bring the numbers: what moved, what you killed, what you learned. We'll push back on at least one decision on purpose.

3. Leore, our founder and CEO — 45 minutes. Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore, and he's in design loops daily, so this is a working conversation. Bring a point of view on a marketplace surface you'd go after first and why.

4. Reference check(s) — 15 minutes with a former manager or close cross-functional partner

Compensation: $200,000 - $245,000 per year plus equity


WHAT WE OFFER:

For full-time Employees

 - We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available 

 - Generous PTO that people actually take

 - Parental leave at full salary

 - $200/month wellness + $100/month home office stipend

 - Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision

 - Remote-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans

 - 401(k)

 - Alt Equity to all full-time employees

title: Integrated Marketing Manager

snapshot.title: Integrated Marketing Manager
snapshot.descriptionHtml:
Gravity Research is seeking an Integrated Marketing Manager who can translate our research into compelling content and multichannel campaigns that build brand awareness and drive revenue pipeline. This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a strategic marketer and creative who is equally comfortable packaging research into polished marketing materials, developing a campaign concept, designing collateral, launching a campaign, bringing a new product to market, and leveraging AI to raise both the speed and the standard of the work. 

Gravity Research is a premier insights firm helping companies anticipate risk, spot opportunities, and rationalize reputational concerns against a backdrop of evolving public pressures.

The Role
Gravity Research is seeking an Integrated Marketing Manager to lead the company's integrated marketing execution, sales enablement, and visual design across our research and advisory products. This role sits within our Revenue division and works closely with Revenue, Research, and Content leadership to take the research and insights developed by our research team and strategically package and design them into compelling, market-facing collateral and campaigns.

This person will partner closely with our Research and Content teams, including the Senior Director of Content Strategy and Senior Analyst, Market Research & Insights, who are responsible for developing Gravity’s research, thought leadership, and underlying content. Through this partnership, the Integrated Marketing Manager will determine how that work is packaged, visually presented, and brought to market across various channels. The Integrated Marketing Manager will also be directly responsible for designing and producing presentations, one-pagers, graphics, email campaigns, digital assets, and other marketing materials.

This is a cross-functional role focused on ensuring Gravity’s marketing efforts work together to drive awareness, engagement, meetings, and ultimately revenue. This person will take projects from concept through execution, developing integrated campaign strategies while also independently designing and producing the marketing materials needed to bring those campaigns to life.

This role is expected to be AI-fluent, leveraging the latest tools to drive consistency and efficiency across design, campaign, and production workflows.

Your Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Integrated Marketing Campaigns — Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies and campaigns around Gravity’s research, insights, products, and timely topics; determine the right mix of messaging, assets, channels, and timing to drive awareness, engagement, and meetings

  • Research & Insight Packaging — Partner with Research and Content teams to take completed research, key findings, and thought leadership pieces and determine how to package and visually present them for client and prospect audiences across formats and channels

  • Creative & Collateral Development — Independently design and produce polished marketing and sales materials, including reports, presentations, pitch decks, one-pagers, social graphics, digital content, and other visual assets; scope needs with Revenue leadership and keep materials current

  • New Product Go-to-Market — Craft compelling positioning, campaign concepts, and collateral to bring new Gravity products and services to existing and prospective audiences

  • Email & Digital Marketing — Write, design, and deploy HubSpot campaigns tied to research releases, flagship content, new products, and timely insights; manage segmentation, suppressions, deployment timing, and post-send engagement reporting

  • Visual Identity — Maintain brand consistency across all marketing surfaces and bring strong design judgment to how Gravity’s research, insights, and products are presented to the market

  • Marketing Performance & Operations — Track campaign performance and use engagement data to optimize future campaigns; manage HubSpot workflows, CRM hygiene, reporting, and analytics administration in close partnership with the Revenue team; own website updates and LinkedIn presence

  • AI-Powered Workflows — Apply AI tools to accelerate design, campaign development, editing, and production; experiment with new solutions to improve workflow efficiency across the marketing function

    • Qualifications:

    The ideal candidate is both a strategic marketer and hands-on creative, bringing strong design instincts, integrated marketing experience, and the self-direction to take projects from concept through execution. They know how to take complex, research-driven content and determine the most compelling way to package, design, and market it to an executive audience.

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Design, or a related field

  • 2+ years of experience in B2B marketing, integrated marketing, creative marketing, or design, ideally at a research, consulting, or professional services company

  • Experience developing and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns from concept through launch

  • Strong design capabilities with the ability to independently create polished presentations, reports, social graphics, digital content, and other marketing collateral

  • Strong writing and editing skills; comfort translating complex ideas into clear marketing messages across formats and platforms

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign and Illustrator), Canva, or equivalent design tools

  • Proficiency with HubSpot, including campaign management, forms, and reporting; CRM experience preferred

  • Design sensibility calibrated for executive audiences: clean, credible, and not decorative

  • Strong project management skills; able to juggle competing deadlines and move projects from concept through execution independently

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to track campaign performance and use data to optimize future marketing efforts

  • Comfort experimenting with AI tools to improve design, campaign, and production workflows

  • Prodigious work ethic and spirit of generosity

    • Start Date: Available immediately   Employment Type: Full-time   Location: This job is based in Washington, DC. Gravity Research operates on a hybrid schedule, with employees required to be in the office every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.  ______________________________________________________________________________________________________________   About Us Across Gravity Research, generally, the firm looks for three “pillar gifts” in you, and everyone else.  In all of us, these are more aspirational than actual, but they are central in our intentions –   Force of Ideas: At the center of Gravity Research’s work are the ideas within our work. We believe that ideas—the good and not—have consequences. Our ultimate objective is to bring rigor, insight, and intellectual honesty to the goal of separating the bad from the good, and giving voice, argument, and flight to maintaining the latter.   Spirit of Generosity:  Gravity Research seeks in its ranks a spirit of generosity: a natural disposition in each colleague toward service and selfless conduct. Our writing should be cut from the same cloth—critical on the merits, but informed by charity and forbearance in measuring motive and personal character.   Radical Responsibility: We give our people a lot of responsibility early on, and our top performers embrace it. We believe in holding ourselves and our colleagues accountable, taking ownership over big things, striving for excellence, and celebrating success.   Gravity Research is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against our applicants because of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

snapshot.title: AI Builder
snapshot.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT ARTERA

Our Mission: Make healthcare #1 in customer service.   What We Deliver: Artera is an agentic company strengthening how healthcare providers communicate and care for patients. As an agentic partner, we bring over a decade of healthcare experience to address urgent workflows from day one and build custom solutions as healthcare providers’ needs evolve. Trusted by 1,000+ specialties, FQHCs, health systems, and federal agencies, Artera strengthens and protects and enhances patient relationships across every interaction - from intake and scheduling to referral management, post-visit care, and more.

Hear from our CEO, Guillaume de Zwirek, about why we are standing at the edge of the biggest technological shift in healthcare’s history!

Our award-winning culture: Our award-winning culture: Since founding in 2015, Artera has consistently been recognized for its innovative technology, business growth, and named a top place to work. Examples of these accolades include: Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024); Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025); Built In Best Companies to Work For (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026). Artera has also been recognized by Forbes as one of “America’s Best Startup Employers,” Newsweek as one of the “World’s Best Digital Health Companies,” and named one of the top “44 Startups to Bet your Career on in 2024” by Business Insider.   Applicants must be currently authorized and have the ability to provide proof of full-time, long-term authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers now or in the future.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Artera is hiring an AI Builder to build the agentic systems that deliver exceptional patient experiences for our customers — scheduling, referral coordination, medication refills, billing, payment estimation and more. 

You'll be a fully contributing builder inside a customer-facing squad bringing AI-native fluency in delivering end-to-end on your customers’ needs — owning initiatives from customer discovery through production operation, onboarding new customers onto what you build, and shipping enhancements that keep pace with the technical possibilities  for a named subset of our provider customers. Your creativity should be boundless, your desire to deliver world class solutions unmatched, and your initiative and accountability to those outcomes as a new bar for our customers they themselves aspire to. 

At this level, you'll own customer outcomes independently with moderate supervision, bringing the curiosity of a product manager, the discipline of a project manager, and the agentic fluency of an engineer to your work. You'll develop real subject-matter expertise and long term relationships with senior healthcare executives, and internally teach and support newer builders and experiment and advocate for novel agentic techniques that make every Artera customer even more successful. 

Responsibilities

  • Ownership: Own end-to-end delivery and realized outcomes for named customers. Represent Artera credibly in customer conversations, and raise the bar on the customer solutions the squad ships.

  • Strategy: Identify customer pain and create a roadmap for solving their problems.

  • Program Management: Align stakeholders, connect necessary data pipelines, and manage fast and painless onboarding onto our solutions.

  • Agentic Development: Build novel solutions for named customers; translate their operational reality into technical solutions that you yourself architect and code with our internal agentic systems.

  • Continuous Improvement: Instrument, monitor, and improve the reliability of what you ship; create enhancements based on what production actually tells you; participate in on-call where applicable.

  • AI-native: your work across all dimensions will be inherently reliant on  AI-native tools primarily using the CLI; which means you will own a greater breadth and volume of responsibility than a typical technologist.

  • Domain Expertise: Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise in your customer segments (e.g. primary care, community health, orthopedics) and integration surface (e.g., scheduling, referrals, patient messaging, EHR/CCaaS).

  • Mentorship: Mentor and onboard newer builders; review their work with a mindset for raising the bar on agentic techniques and customer orientation.

  • Leadership: Contribute to squad-level prioritization and planning in partnership with the Head of Segment.

    • Requirements

  • 2 - 5 years of professional software engineering, data science, machine learning, product management, product design, or technical project management experience, or equivalent demonstrated output.

  • Demonstrated AI-native fluency with measurable leverage — ability to produce output on par with multiple traditional engineers using AI-native tools (e.g., Claude Code in the terminal) as the primary working environment; ability to learn new technology quickly 

  • Track record of shipping solutions end-to-end that ran reliably in production, including the enhancements that followed.

  • Ability to work directly and productively with customers — onboarding them, owning the relationship, and translating customer conversations into technical decisions.

  • Curiosity of a product manager and discipline of a project manager: asks "why" before "how," scopes and sequences work, communicates status, and lands the work.

  • Written and verbal communication sufficient to present complicated concepts to teammates, managers, and customers with the appropriate level of detail.

  • Demonstrated ability to teach and support less senior teammates, and to raise the bar on the solutions the squad delivers to customers.

    • Bonus

  • Prior experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or patient-facing products.

  • Hands-on experience building production agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or MCP-based tool integrations.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA, HITRUST, or FedRAMP compliance considerations in builds.

  • Experience with EHR integrations (Epic, athena, eClinicalWorks, NextGen) or call center / CCaaS integrations.

  • Experience writing evals and quality benchmarks for LLM-driven systems.

    • This role supports a federal-facing product and is considered essential to secure operations. Candidates must meet eligibility for a government background check and comply with organizational security policies and federal data protection standards. The position includes responsibilities related to secure access, incident response, and operational continuity. Ongoing training and adherence to compliance requirements will be required.

    OUR APPROACH TO WORK LOCATION

    At Artera, we believe the best work happens when people are truly connected. Our AI services model has shown what’s possible when small, focused teams move fast together — the speed of collaboration, pace of career growth, and quality of what we build can become stronger when teams share space. As we grow, we want every new teammate to feel part of an in-person community from day one.

    That’s why we are focusing our U.S. hiring in three cities, where we are investing in offices and building strong local teams:

    • Santa Barbara, CA (Our HQ)
    • Seattle, WA
    • Kansas City, KS/MO

    Unless a role’s posting states otherwise, new U.S. roles are based in one of these three cities, and candidates should reside in (or be willing to relocate to) one of these areas. Each location follows an in-person schedule that reflects how our local teams work best; we’ll walk you through what to expect for your specific role and city during the interview process.

    Focusing on offices and hiring in a few locations, rather than spreading thin across many cities, lets us invest deeply in each one so every team has real community, mentorship, and momentum in person.

    WORKING AT ARTERA 

    Company benefits - Full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short-term & long-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k) and more!  Career development - Manager development resources, employee development funds Generous time off - Company holidays, Winter & Summer break, and flexible time off Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) - We believe that everyone should belong at their workplace. Our ERGs are available for identifying employees or allies to join.   

    EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY (EEO) STATEMENT

    Artera is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fair and equitable hiring practices. All hiring decisions at Artera are based on strategic business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. title: Founding Account Executive

snapshot.text:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Founding Account Executive at Creem, you'll own the full sales motion end to end, from first conversation to closed deal to a growing account. We're building our sales function from scratch, and you're the person who gets to define how it works. You'll be the face of Creem to our highest value prospects: understanding what they're building, showing them how a Merchant of Record removes their tax, compliance, and payments burden, and closing them.

This is a full stack sales role in the truest sense. You'll prospect, qualify, run discovery, demo, negotiate, close, and then keep those high value accounts growing as their account executive. There's no SDR to hand you leads and no sales ops team behind you. You build the pipeline, you run the cycle, you own the number.

What makes this role different is the technical layer. We expect you to navigate the AI world comfortably and have real technical literacy. When you need lead data enriched, you set up the enrichment yourself. When a workflow in Attio or PostHog needs automating, you build it rather than filing a ticket. You'll use AI and automation to make one person operate like a full team, and what you build now becomes the sales infrastructure the company scales on.

This role carries founder level responsibility. Your vision and execution establish how Creem sells for years to come.

WHAT WE VALUE

- Autonomy with Impact: We don't dictate tasks. You choose the work that moves revenue the most.
- Problem Solvers: Our sales motion is still being invented. We need someone who acts fast, tests, and iterates.
- Technical Excellence: We prioritize high talent density and technical capability across every role, sales included.
- AI First Mindset: Every team member contributes to our AI approach through automation and technical leverage.

REQUIREMENTS

- Full Cycle Ownership: You've carried a quota and run deals end to end, from prospecting through close, ideally selling technical or financial products to developers, founders, or software teams.
- High Value Account Instinct: You know how to sell to and grow larger accounts, reading what matters to each stakeholder and building real relationships rather than pushing a script.
- Technical Literacy: You're genuinely comfortable in the AI and automation world. You can enrich lead data, wire up integrations, and automate parts of your own workflow without waiting on engineering.
- Scrappy Pipeline Building: You can build lightweight systems to find, research, and reach the right prospects without enterprise infrastructure.
- Founding Team Collaboration: You thrive working directly with founders, translating our vision into a sales motion while wearing multiple hats.
- Building at Scale Zero: You're excited to build a sales function from nothing and prioritize what delivers revenue fastest with minimal resources.

BONUS POINTS

- Attio and PostHog Fluency: You've worked hands on with a modern CRM and product analytics, and can bend both to your needs.
- Merchant of Record or Payments Background: You understand how software businesses handle payments, tax, and compliance, and can speak the language of the people you're selling to.
- Builder's Track Record: You've built and monetized your own projects, so you understand the customer from the inside.
- Community and Network: You bring relationships in the indie hacker, SaaS, or developer world that turn into pipeline.

OUR OFFER TO YOU

- Exceptional Compensation: A highly competitive package with real upside tied to what you close.
- Meaningful Equity: Real skin in the game as a founding member of the sales team.
- Relocation Support: Comprehensive relocation assistance, visa processing if needed, and first month's rent covered.
- Growth Budget: Dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and resources.
- Trust and Flexibility: We trust you to manage your energy and take time when you need it.
- Team Adventures: We work hard together and get out into the world together.

Support early-stage opportunity shaping by helping prospects understand risks, gaps, and potential business impact 


Create and deliver compelling technical presentations aligned with both technical buyers and executive stakeholders

Stay current on application security trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies

Proven ability to support new business sales cycles in partnership with quota-carrying Account Executives 


Strong understanding of application security concepts, vulnerabilities, and testing methodologies 


Hands-on or working experience with SAST, SCA, or DAST technologies

Technical background in software development, security engineering, or related fields 


Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences 


Demonstrated ability to influence technical decision-makers and build credibility quickly in early-stage engagements

Experience supporting high-growth, hunter-led sales environments

title: Founding Design Engineer

snapshot.text:
ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a founding-level, high-ownership position sitting at the intersection of design and engineering. You'll be the sole bar-raiser for frontend UX across a fast-moving, early-stage B2B SaaS company building an AI-powered pricing optimization platform. Your work will ensure that human-authored and agent-written UIs feel like one coherent, polished product — covering everything from the design system and component library to conversational surfaces on platforms like Slack and Microsoft Teams.

You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders and a small, tight-knit engineering team, with enormous scope and direct influence over the product's quality and direction from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design system end-to-end: design tokens, a shadcn/ui-based component library, and Tailwind CSS conventions applied consistently across the product suite.

 - Define and enforce frontend patterns using React Query, React Hook Form, and Zod — ensuring agent-written PRs land consistent and polished by default.

 - Shape conversational agent interfaces for constrained platforms (Slack Block Kit, Microsoft Teams Adaptive Cards), bringing the same visual and interaction quality as the core product.

 - Codify accessibility standards — implement WCAG contrast rules and guardrails directly into brand guidelines and the codebase.

 - Maintain and improve frontend tooling and quality: Biome configuration, Playwright E2E test coverage, and frontend performance optimization.

 - Translate design intent into code: reusable component abstractions, motion (e.g., Framer Motion, Radix transitions), and tactile micro-interactions.

 - Partner cross-functionally with founders and engineers to keep the frontend a thin, polished layer over the API.

 - Integrate AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) and custom lint/agent rules into the frontend workflow.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves (dealbreakers):

 - 5+ years building product interfaces, with a portfolio of shipped features demonstrating high polish.

 - Primary ownership of a production design system or component library (public repo, portfolio, or detailed walkthrough required).

 - Deep expertise in React, strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and component primitives (shadcn/ui, Radix UI).

 - Authorized to work in the US — visa sponsorship is not available.

Required skills & experience:

 - Strong systems thinking: ability to translate visual decisions into tokens, component abstractions, and lint rules.

 - Experience enforcing WCAG accessibility standards and integrating them into a living codebase.

 - Hands-on experience with AI coding tools in production workflows (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).

 - Comfort acting as the sole frontend UX standard-setter across a company — you raise the bar, you own it.

Nice to have:

 - Experience building non-standard AI interfaces: streaming responses, generative canvases, human-in-the-loop views.

 - Experience designing and shipping conversational interfaces or chatbots for B2B end-users.

 - Familiarity with Slack Block Kit, Microsoft Teams Adaptive Cards, or CLI design patterns for constrained UI spaces.

 - Experience with animation and UI state transition tooling (Framer Motion, Radix) to enhance perceived speed and polish.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $180,000 – $220,000 USD annually

 - Founding team equity commensurate with early-stage, high-ownership role

 - Direct impact on product direction and technical culture from day one


LOCATION

This role is on-site in San Francisco, CA. The team works together in person; remote-only candidates are not a fit for this position.

title: Vice President, Product Management

snapshot.text:
Job Title: Vice President, Product Management
Department: Product Development 
About the Role: Unite Us is seeking a Vice President, Product Management to lead the product organization responsible for our platform and product suite.
Our customers span government agencies, health systems, health plans, and community-based organizations (CBOs). They rely on Unite Us to identify needs, coordinate services across sectors, manage referrals and cases, and measure impact. Doing that well means building products that work for a caseworker at a small food pantry and a CIO at a national health plan, on the same platform, with the same commitment to privacy and dignity.
You'll help set the product vision and strategy, lead a team of product directors and managers, and own the portfolio from investment decision to measurable outcome. You'll shape how our platform scales: the shared services, identity, interoperability, and data foundations that let many teams ship independently without fragmenting the experience. And you'll bring the discipline that connects every product bet to customer value, financial results, and the people we ultimately serve.
This is a senior leadership role for a builder. If you've architected platforms yourself, led product at scale in a complex healthcare environment, and helped grow a team from good to great, this is a good fit.
What You'll Do:
Product Vision and Strategy

Define and communicate a multi-year product vision and strategy aligned with company goals, customer needs, and the evolving policy landscape for health and community care.
Translate strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and make hard tradeoff decisions with confidence and transparency.
Stay close to customers, frontline users, and market trends, including government programs, value-based care, and reimbursement models for non-medical services.
Identify where AI and advanced analytics can meaningfully improve how needs are identified, how services are coordinated, and how outcomes are measured.
Represent product strategy to the executive team, the board, and key customers and partners.

Portfolio and Investment Management

Own the product portfolio, including investment allocation, initiative sizing, and return on investment across product lines.
Build product intelligence that links initiatives to financials and outcomes, so leaders can see what we're spending, what we're getting, and what to stop.
Run recurring business reviews with executive leadership that hold product, engineering, and business teams accountable to shared outcomes.
Rationalize and consolidate overlapping capabilities to reduce cost, complexity, and security exposure.

Platform, Identity, and Interoperability

Lead the evolution of the Unite Us platform toward configurable, reusable capabilities that let decentralized teams deliver a unified experience.
Champion a secure, scalable identity strategy, including single sign-on (SSO), OAuth and OpenID Connect (OIDC), role-based access control (RBAC), and multi-factor authentication.
Partner with Interoperability Solutions Delivery and Engineering to grow our integration portfolio, including FHIR, SMART on FHIR, HL7, electronic health record (EHR) integrations, and partner APIs.
Ensure products meet regulatory and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, and interoperability rules such as the 21st Century Cures Act.
Build a third-party and partner ecosystem that extends the value of our network.

Product Organization and Leadership

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product directors and product managers, building a culture of empowered, outcome-focused teams.
Establish consistent product practices across teams: discovery, prioritization, outcome measurement, and storytelling about what we've learned and delivered.
Recruit and develop strong product talent, and create clear paths for growth.
Celebrate outcomes, not just output, and make sure wins are shared across the company.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Engineering and Design leadership as a unified product development leadership team.
Work with Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation to understand customer needs, support strategic deals, and ensure what we sell is what we deliver.
Collaborate with Marketing on positioning, launches, and how we tell the story of our products.
Engage directly with customers and partners, including executive stakeholders at health plans, health systems, and government agencies.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

12+ years of experience in product management, solution architecture, or health information technology, with 5+ years leading product teams and product leaders
Led a large, multi-team product portfolio in healthcare, health plans, or health IT, and you can speak to the investment, outcome, and financial results of your decisions
Technical foundation deep enough to go toe-to-toe with architects on platform, identity, and API strategy, ideally because you've been one
Delivered interoperability capabilities in production, such as FHIR APIs, SMART on FHIR applications, or EHR integrations
Built or scaled a platform that lets many independent teams deliver a consistent experience
Understand the regulatory environment for health data, including HIPAA and the 21st Century Cures Act
Introduced product operating practices into an organization and made them stick
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including with executives, boards, and customer leadership
Comfortable presenting to large audiences, and you enjoy teaching and developing others
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ambiguity and competing priorities
Commitment to social impact initiatives and helping underserved communities
Experience serving special populations, such as Medicaid members, foster youth, or people receiving long-term services and supports (LTSS) a plus
Experience with customer identity and access management (CIAM) platforms, such as Ping Identity or Okta a plus
Background in clinical informatics or clinical decision support a plus
Experience applying AI to product operations, portfolio management, or the product itself a plus
Experience in a project-funded organization moving toward a product operating model a plus
Published research, industry conference presentations, or teaching experience in health information technology or health administration a plus
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Public Health, or a related field; master's degree in Health Administration, Public Health, Business, or a related field strongly preferred

Technical Tools:

Product and Roadmapping: Jira, Productboard, Aha!, or similar
Analytics: Sigma, Looker, Tableau, or similar
CRM Tools: Intercom, Jira
Documentation Tools: Confluence, Google Suite
Project Management Tools: Asana
Performance Management Tool: Lattice
Internal Tools: Workday, Zoom, Slack, Workramp

What success looks like:

In your first 90 days: you know our customers, products, and team; you've met key customers and partners; and you've shared an initial assessment of the portfolio and the product organization.
By six months: a clear product vision and roadmap are in place and understood across the company, every major initiative is tied to measurable outcomes and financials, and consistent product practices are running across teams.
By a year: the portfolio is simpler and more focused, the platform lets teams ship faster with less duplication, and we can show measurable improvements in customer outcomes and product-driven revenue.

Our Mission:
Unite Us’ mission is to unlock the potential of every community. Our co-founders started Unite Us in 2013 to serve the people they served with. They witnessed firsthand the barriers and inefficiencies in trying to navigate health and social services, and set out to improve that experience for veterans and their families. Unite Us quickly expanded to serving all people who need connections to care across our country. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities. We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. If you want to do well and do good, join Unite Us.

This position is remote, U.S. based. 
This position may require 25% travel
The target pay range for this role is: $225,000-$265,000. This salary range represents our target hiring range for this role. The proposed salary will be dependent on the candidate's skills, experience, and competencies, as well as location.
All team members will be required to pass a background check which includes criminal, employment, and education verification 

Benefits provided by Unite Us:

We offer insurance to team members and eligible partners and dependents, including unlimited virtual mental health and acute medical visits.

Mental health benefits, such as the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness platform subscription, are available to all team members.

We offer tax-advantaged health savings accounts (HSAs), flexible spending accounts (FSAs), and commuter benefits.

Enjoy matching, immediate vesting and financial wellness resources

Accident Insurance
Pet Insurance

At our flagship clinic, we deliver premium, prevention-first executive health exams powered by advanced diagnostics and AI-driven insights. Our mission is to create a world where proactive, deeply personal care is accessible to all—through both a luxury in-clinic experience and transformative technology.   About the Role: We are seeking a hands-on, AI-forward Financial Controller who will play a critical role in managing and strengthening the financial operations that support our next stage of growth. This is not a traditional back-office accounting role.

The Financial Controller will own the day-to-day financial operations of the company while actively leveraging AI, automation, and modern financial tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, reporting, and financial controls. This individual should be excited about identifying processes that can be automated or AI-assisted and implementing smarter, more scalable ways of working.

The ideal candidate combines a strong foundation in finance and accounting with a technology-forward mindset, thrives in a growing company environment, enjoys solving operational challenges, and takes full ownership of the financial health of the organization.

Location & Schedule

This is a hybrid role requiring on-site attendance at our San Antonio clinic two days per week and its Austin clinic one day per month. 

Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, and paid time off. Team members also enjoy access to unique perks such as discounts on IV therapy and M-Sculpt sessions, free onsite yoga, and catered healthy lunches.  

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the day-to-day accounting operations across multiple Medici entities.

  • Manage accounts receivable, including membership billing, service invoicing, payment reconciliation, collections, and account maintenance.

  • Ensure all recurring membership and service invoices are generated accurately and on time.

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable billing and payment tracking processes that ensure accurate invoicing, timely collections, and clear visibility into customer payment status.

  • Leverage AI, automation, and modern financial technology to streamline accounting and finance workflows, improve accuracy, reduce manual processes, and strengthen financial controls.

  • Proactively identify opportunities across accounts receivable, accounts payable, reconciliation, reporting, forecasting, and other financial processes that can be automated or AI-assisted.

  • Evaluate and implement tools, workflows, and process improvements that create a more scalable and technology-enabled finance function.

  • Manage accounts payable, including vendor payments, contractor payments, employee reimbursements, expense review, and oversight of Bill.com workflows and approvals.

  • Maintain accurate financial records and oversee all activity within QuickBooks.

  • Lead month-end and year-end close processes, including reconciliations and financial reporting.

  • Prepare monthly financial statements and provide reporting to leadership.

  • Monitor cash flow and support budgeting and forecasting activities.

  • Coordinate payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments for employees and international contractors.

  • Partner with external accountants, auditors, and tax advisors as needed.

  • Develop and improve financial processes, controls, billing workflows, and reporting procedures to support company growth.

  • Work closely with Operations, Care Concierge, and Leadership teams to ensure accurate billing, reporting, and financial management across the organization.

  • Identify process gaps, resolve financial discrepancies, and proactively improve operational efficiency.

    • Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI, automation, or technology to improve finance and accounting processes, with the ability to identify opportunities to automate workflows, increase efficiency, improve accuracy, and strengthen financial controls.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of progressive accounting, finance, or financial operations experience.

  • Strong foundation in accounting principles, financial reporting, reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial controls.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to improve processes and build scalable financial workflows.

  • Experience working with accounting and financial management systems; QuickBooks experience preferred.

  • Experience with accounts payable and payment platforms such as Bill.com or similar systems preferred.

  • Experience with multi-entity financial operations, recurring revenue, memberships, subscriptions, or healthcare billing preferred.

  • CPA or similar professional accounting designation preferred, but not required.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of outcomes, and thrive in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment.

  • Curiosity and willingness to continuously evaluate emerging AI and financial technologies that can improve how the finance function operates.

    • Our Culture

  • Medici is a high-performing team that genuinely enjoys working together. We care deeply about our mission and about each other. We value personal ownership, strong communication, and supporting one another’s growth. Health and wellness are part of our culture—both professionally and personally. Team gatherings have included yoga and sound bath sessions, trying new fitness classes together,playing pickleball and bowling together, and sharing farm-to-table dinners. We’re ambitious and driven, but we also believe in balance, connection, and building a company we’re proud of. We’re a high-trust team. Leadership is supportive and available, but we don’t micromanage—this role requires strong judgment, follow-through, and comfort working independently.
  • We’re also values-driven, and faith is important to our CEO and present in our culture; we welcome people of all backgrounds who align with how we work.
    • Important: This is a confidential search. All candidate submissions and inquiries must go through Elizabeth Barriga. Please do not contact members of the executive team regarding this role. Doing so may result in disqualification from consideration.   All Agency and candidate engagement is through Elizabeth Barriga: elizabethb@medi.ci

snapshot.text:
ABOUT ONEPAY

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

 - Ready to run

 - Hungry and driven by urgency

 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

 - Comfortable operating in motion




THE ROLE

As a Platform Engineer on the Builder Experience Team at OnePay, you will build the core platform services and developer frameworks that power large-scale, distributed systems and enable the next generation of intelligent, agent-driven applications.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and operate platform-oriented core services that support high-scale distributed systems across OnePay’s product ecosystem

 - Develop internal developer tooling and shared infrastructure that improve velocity, reliability, and observability across engineering teams

 - Build and evolve frameworks that support the construction and orchestration of agentic applications, enabling intelligent, automated workflows across products

 - Drive enhancements in CI/CD pipelines, automation, and developer workflows to increase deployment speed, reliability, and confidence across teams

 


YOU BRING

 - 2-9 years of experience in software engineering within fintech, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale distributed systems environments

 - Experience building developer platforms, internal tooling, or frameworks that enable other engineers to move faster

 - Deep expertise in distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and high-availability platform services

 - Production experience in AWS cloud environments and building cloud-native infrastructure

 - Demonstrated experience designing and building agentic developer tools that empower automation, collaboration, or intelligent workflows

 - Strong experience working with CI/CD pipelines and driving continuous integration and delivery improvements

 - Drive and proactivity – everyone here is a builder and executor




TOOLS WE USE

We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

 - 401(k) plan with company match

 - Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact




STANDARD INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

 - AI-assisted initial screen

 - Interview with Talent Partner

 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

 - Team Interview

 - Executive Interview

 - Offer!




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

location: Primary: Bay Area (San Francisco/Peninsula) | Secondary: NYC

snapshot.text:
About Us
Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.We are building a first-of-its-kind consumer mobile product from the ground up. As a Product Manager, you'll be assigned a specific feature area to own end-to-end the exact scope will be defined based on team needs and your background, and shared in more detail during the interview process from spec to shipped feature to the metrics that tell you whether it worked. There is no legacy roadmap and no bloated process to inherit just a zero-to-one build, a small high-output team, and an AI-native way of working that lets one person do the job that used to take three.
This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a technical design review as they are in a user research readout. You'll work directly with engineering, design, and outside partners to turn ambiguous ideas into requirements an engineering team can actually build against.
The Product

You will help build the features millions of users actually touch inside a new mobile consumer product anchored around the MrBeast audience. This isn't a passive content app it's a highly interactive platform built to turn the world's largest audience into an engaged community at global scale. Further details shared during the interview process.

What You'll Do

Own the product lifecycle for a specific feature area of the app (to be assigned based on team needs) from opportunity sizing and requirements through launch and post-launch iteration translating ambiguous creative and business goals into clear, testable specs engineering can build against.
Write and maintain product requirements, acceptance criteria, and gap analyses that hold up under real engineering and QA scrutiny not just slide decks.
Partner daily with engineering leads and designers in tight iteration loops; be in the details of the build, not just the roadmap.
Use AI tools as a default part of how you work from drafting specs and synthesizing research to prototyping flows and querying data so your output is materially faster than a traditional PM's.
Bring an AI-first product lens to the roadmap itself: identify where AI can improve the member experience (personalization, matchmaking, moderation, content generation, support) and turn those ideas into shippable specs.

snapshot.descriptionHtml:
About doola
doola is a dynamic company committed to simplifying the complexities of business formation, payment setup, compliance, taxes, and more. We empower entrepreneurs and businesses of all sizes to navigate the intricate landscape of financial and regulatory requirements with ease, allowing them to focus on what truly matters - building and growing their ventures.


Job Description
doola is looking for an FP&A Analyst to maintain and support the financial planning and reporting engine for the company. This person will turn closed books and operating data into forecasts, budget vs. actuals reporting, KPI dashboards, cash and runway visibility, and decision support for leadership.
This role is ideal for someone who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a fast-moving startup environment. You will partner closely with the Head of Finance, the Finance Analyst, and department leaders to help doola make better operating decisions, manage spend, understand performance, and prepare for board, investor, and strategic finance needs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain the company forecast model, including actuals updates, revenue assumptions, expense forecasts, headcount planning, cash forecasting, runway scenarios, and scenario planning.
  • Prepare monthly budget vs. actuals reporting that explains what happened, why it happened, and what leadership should consider doing next.
  • Partner with department owners to provide visibility into spend, headcount, budgets, forecasts, and material risks.
  • Maintain recurring KPI, cash, and runway reporting to help leadership understand company performance, burn, runway, and operating trends.
  • Support board, investor, fundraising, and strategic finance needs through financial analysis, KPI backup, variance explanations, scenario analysis, and supporting schedules.
  • Build repeatable reporting processes and templates that improve the monthly finance rhythm and reduce dependency on the Head of Finance.
  • Work with accounting and the Finance Analyst to ensure actuals are grounded in the accounting close and tied to reliable source systems.
  • Use AI and automation tools to make recurring finance workflows faster, more accurate, and more repeatable while maintaining proper review and control.
Skills and Qualifications
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or startup finance.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including experience building or maintaining forecasts, budgets, management reporting, and scenario analysis.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Experience preparing budget vs. actuals reporting and variance analysis.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS or subscription business metrics, including ARR, MRR, churn, retention, CAC, payback, gross margin, burn, and runway.
  • Strong analytical rigor and attention to detail, with the ability to reconcile outputs to source systems and check assumptions before sharing work.
  • Strong business judgment, including the ability to separate signal from noise, flag material issues, and recommend actions based on analysis.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain finance concepts clearly to non-finance leaders.
  • Ability to work directly with business owners and department leaders, not only finance teams.
  • Ability to own recurring processes, manage deadlines, track open items, and follow through without constant direction.
  • Experience using AI or automation tools to improve reporting, analysis, documentation, or recurring workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in finance, accounting, economics, business, engineering, math, or another analytical field

Bonus Qualifications

  • Startup finance experience.
  • SaaS, subscription, fintech, marketplace, or high-growth company experience.
  • Experience with QuickBooks, Stripe, ChartMogul, HubSpot, Brex, Gusto, or similar systems.
  • Experience supporting board materials, investor updates, fundraising, or annual planning.
  • Comfort partnering with accounting without trying to own the close.
  • Experience creating AI-assisted reporting workflows, data review processes, or finance automations.
  • Experience working in a lean finance team where ownership, judgment, and speed are critical.

    •  

    Why Join Us

  • Support the FP&A engine for a high-growth startup and help shape how leadership makes decisions.
  • Work directly with the Head of Finance and company leaders on forecasting, budgeting, KPI reporting, cash planning, board support, and strategic analysis.
  • Build high-leverage finance processes from the ground up, with meaningful room to improve reporting, automation, and operating cadence.
  • Play a key role in helping doola prepare for its next stage of growth, including board, investor, fundraising, and strategic planning needs.
  • Opportunity to work with a dynamic and innovative company at the forefront of the industry.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment with opportunities for growth and development.
  • Flexibility to work remotely from anywhere with a stable internet connection.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

    • If you are passionate about helping businesses succeed and thrive, and you possess the skills and experience outlined above, we want to hear from you! Join us at doola and be part of a team dedicated to simplifying the path to business success. 

    doola is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
