title: Creative Technologist (AI Design Engineer)

snapshot.text:
CREATIVE TECHNOLOGIST (AI DESIGN ENGINEER)

Also known as: Creative Workflow Specialist · AI Workflow Designer




🎨 ABOUT OPENART

OpenArt is a leading AI Creative Platform for visual storytelling, used by millions worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We're bringing those tools together into one agentic creative environment: it understands what you mean, orchestrates the right capabilities, and still leaves you in full control of the work. We believe the future of creativity is AI-native, and we're shaping that future.




🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

We're building tools that expand what's creatively possible — and, increasingly, an agent that does the work: it understands what a creator wants, picks the right models and tools, runs the job, and hands back something they can see, adjust, and finish. For that to hold up in professional production, the agent has to know the work from the inside.

That's where you come in. We need someone who sits between creators and product to turn real pain points in professional workflows into solutions that run and can be proven. If you know professional creative production from the inside and you're used to building your own ideas into interactive prototypes with AI, this might be your seat.

We're not just looking for someone who makes demos. We're looking for someone who finds the problem, researches the workflow, delivers the prototype end to end, makes the case for it, and then hands it to engineering to ship.




🚀 WHY JOIN OPENART

 - Your prototypes become products. What you build won't stop at a demo. Validated prototypes go straight onto the product roadmap and are taken to launch by engineering.

 - Work at the frontier of AI and creativity. You'll be among the first to get hands-on with new models and capabilities, and as a practitioner, you'll decide what shape they take inside creators' workflows — and what the agent should do with them on a creator's behalf.

 - Direct impact on product direction. Your judgment won't sit in a review queue. From identifying problems to validating prototypes, you'll directly shape what OpenArt builds next.

 - Hyper-growth and huge market opportunity. OpenArt is one of the largest AI video generation platforms globally, with millions of monthly active users and partnerships with top model players including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, BytePlus, and Kling.

 - Define where creative tools go next. Generation gets cheaper every month; what creators and clients pay for is finished work. An agent that does the whole job is where the category is heading, and the person who knows production from the inside is the one who decides what it does.




🧩 REQUIREMENTS

 - ndependently takeFluency in professional creative pipelines. Hands-on experience in professional creative production such as advertising, film, or content. You understand every stage from brief to delivery and can pinpoint where the real bottlenecks are.

 - Moves fluidly between design and engineering. AI is your core tool for building. You're proficient with AI coding tools, model APIs, agent frameworks, and lightweight code, and can independently turn concepts into working prototypes fast.

 - End-to-end delivery. You can i work from problem definition and workflow research through interaction design, visual design, and a usable prototype, delivered to a standard professional users can work with directly.

 - Strong product taste. You hold a high bar for craft, polish, and interaction quality, and you know the difference between something that works and something that works well.

 - A body of work that proves it. A portfolio or GitHub showing the tools, prototypes, products, or experiments you've built. We care far more about what you've made than where you've worked.




🌟 NICE TO HAVE

 - Proficiency with professional creative tools. Editing, compositing, motion, or 3D tools. You don't just know how to use them; you know where they fall short on real projects.

 - Background in advertising, film, or content production. You've felt the pressure of professional production firsthand and know what clients and teams actually need before a deadline.

 - Experience at a creative lab, innovation agency, or AI product team. You're comfortable moving through ambiguity and turning new technology into something concrete and usable.

 - You've built with agents. Tool-calling, MCP, skills, or your own automations — anything where the AI did part of the job for you, and you learned where it should and shouldn't be trusted.




🛠 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Identify where workflows break. Embed in the real production work of our in-house creative team and enterprise clients to pinpoint bottlenecks — and the places where an agent doing the work first would change what a team can ship.

 - Teach the agent the job. Turn what you learn into workflows the agent can run end to end — a brief into a set of finished ad variants, one video into ten languages, a winning ad into every placement size — and define what "done to a professional standard" means for each, so what comes back is usable without a second pass.

 - Turn complex generative workflows into intuitive experiences. As models and workflows grow more capable and more complex, decide what the agent should simply handle and where a professional needs to step in to see, adjust, and finish — so creators stay in control of the work instead of waiting on a black box.

 - Rapidly prototype new concepts. Use AI tools, Figma, lightweight code, and APIs to explore interaction patterns and validate ideas, taking them from early concept to polished interface, including motion, transitions, and micro-interactions.

 - Define what each prototype needs to prove. Before each prototype, be clear on the hypothesis it's testing. After, assess what was learned and make a clear call: scale, iterate, or stop.

 - Drive from concept to launch. Work closely with product, model, and engineering teams to turn validated prototypes into shipped features, and build up reusable components and interaction patterns along the way, so the next workflow reaches creators faster.




💰 COMPENSATION

 - Competitive TC including base salary, bonus, and equity (based on experience).

 - Meaningful equity ownership in what you build.




🌍 WORK SETUP

 - San Carlos, CA (full-time, on-site or hybrid)

 - Visa sponsorship available

🧠 ABOUT LEGION HEALTH

At Legion Health https://legionhealth.com, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications https://nypost.com/2026/03/27/business/artificial-intelligence-can-now-prescribe-mental-health-drugs/, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.




📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

 - Job Type: Full-Time

 - Role Type: GTM Engineering / Revenue Systems / Provider Partnerships / AI Automation / Data & Attribution

 - Ideal Experience Level: 5+ years, including 3+ years owning GTM systems, revenue automation, growth engineering, or technical RevOps

 - Location: In-Person in San Francisco, CA

 - US Visa Sponsorship: Yes




🚀 THE OPPORTUNITY

Legion is hiring a GTM Engineer to build the AI-native commercial and referral infrastructure behind our provider-partnership motion. Your systems will help us identify the right provider organizations, reach the right stakeholders, turn interest into referrals, and move referred patients into care quickly.

This is not a traditional RevOps or CRM administration job. You will own the technical architecture from market mapping and outbound through referral intake, attribution, eligibility, onboarding, and partner reporting. You will configure best-in-class tools when they are sufficient and write code or build integrations, agents, and internal products when they are not.

You will build both sides of our sales motion. From the bottom up, Legion needs a complete view of every clinic, location, physician, referral coordinator, and office leader in a market. From the top down, we need to map enterprise medical groups, centralized referral teams, executives, clinical leaders, and every stakeholder who can shape a partnership. The system should tell each representative who matters, why they matter, what happened last, and what to do next.

You will also engineer the path from referral to care. Referrals may arrive through fax, forms, APIs, tracked links, QR codes, phone calls, or patients who begin online after a provider recommendation. Regardless of channel, Legion must identify the source, resolve the provider and organization, preserve attribution, process the referral, initiate eligibility and onboarding, and synchronize the right data across our CRM, product, analytics, and patient-engagement systems.

The right person is a hands-on systems builder with strong product judgment. You should be comfortable choosing a CRM, modeling complex account hierarchies, writing SQL and lightweight production code, integrating APIs, deploying AI workflows, debugging failures, and partnering with sales, product, engineering, data, operations, clinical, compliance, and security teams. Over time, you will help turn provider partnerships into a secure product that makes Legion the easiest specialty care partner in the country: simple to refer patients to, easy to collaborate with, and consistently responsive.




✅ RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

 - Select and architect Legion’s provider-partnership CRM—whether HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, or another AI-native platform—as the source of truth for organizations, locations, stakeholders, opportunities, referrals, ownership, and next actions. 

 - Design a durable account hierarchy that connects individual clinicians, clinic locations, care teams, medical groups, parent organizations, enterprise partnerships, and internal owners without losing history or context.

 - Build a provider prospecting data layer using NPI and claims data, Definitive Healthcare or similar datasets, public sources, enrichment providers, and Legion’s internal data.

 - Create account-scoring and territory systems that prioritize targets using geography, specialty, patient volume, payer mix, referral potential, network relationships, and engagement signals.

 - Build coordinated outbound workflows across email, phone, LinkedIn, direct mail, events, lunch-and-learns, and field sales using tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sequencing platforms, AI agents, and custom integrations.

 - Map clinic-level champions and referral coordinators alongside enterprise executives, clinical leaders, operations leaders, and centralized referral teams so Legion can sell from the bottom up and the top down.

 - Equip sales representatives with accurate contact data, office addresses, account briefs, relationship history, meeting preparation, follow-up automation, and clear next-best actions.

 - Deploy AI-assisted workflows for account research, stakeholder discovery, enrichment, outreach drafting, call intelligence, CRM updates, and follow-up with appropriate evaluations and human review.

 - Build an omnichannel referral-ingestion layer that turns fax, forms, APIs, tracked links, QR codes, phone calls, provider handoffs, and patients who begin online after a provider recommendation into structured, traceable records.

 - Automate referral processing, including document extraction, provider and organization matching, deduplication, completeness checks, routing, exception handling, and audit trails.

 - Connect referral intake to insurance eligibility and AI-native front-desk workflows for patient outreach, onboarding, and scheduling so referred patients reach the right next step without avoidable delays.

 - Own end-to-end attribution across the referring clinician, clinic, parent organization, partnership, sales representative, campaign, channel, UTM, QR code, landing page, fax source, and downstream patient journey.

 - Integrate the provider CRM, Legion’s database, the patient-facing CRM, PostHog, Braze or another lifecycle platform, analytics systems, and custom applications into one coherent data flow.

 - Partner with product and engineering to build secure provider-facing dashboards and workflows for referral volume, referral status, time-to-contact, scheduling progress, coverage and copay information, and other authorized care-coordination information.

 - Build compliant workflows that return medical records, care summaries, and status updates to referring care teams through approved fax, secure email, portal, interoperability, or other authorized channels at the right cadence.

 - Create dashboards and operating reviews for market coverage, stakeholder penetration, outreach performance, pipeline, referral volume, conversion, speed to care, repeat referrals, partner expansion, and revenue impact.

 - Own production reliability across monitoring, logging, retries, rate-limit handling, identity resolution, testing, versioning, access control, documentation, and recovery when systems fail.

 - Treat HIPAA, PHI handling, minimum-necessary access, role-based permissions, audit trails, consent, and provider trust as product requirements in every automated workflow.

 - Make disciplined build-versus-buy decisions, ship useful first versions quickly, and drive adoption through clear playbooks, training, and change management.




🏆 YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU…

 - Give Legion a provider CRM and data model that the team trusts as the source of truth.

 - Create a complete, prioritized map of each market so representatives spend time with the right organizations and people.

 - Build a repeatable outbound engine that produces qualified provider conversations and pipeline through coordinated digital, field, bottom-up, and top-down plays.

 - Ensure every referral is captured, processed, routed, and attributed correctly regardless of how it arrives.

 - Reduce the time from referral to eligibility, patient contact, onboarding, scheduling, and completed care.

 - Give referring care teams a secure, useful experience that increases trust and repeat referrals.

 - Remove repetitive research, data entry, document processing, routing, follow-up, and reporting work without sacrificing accuracy or judgment.

 - Build reliable systems that sales and operations adopt, improve continuously, and measurably increase referral volume, conversion, speed to care, partner retention, and revenue.




🧰 IDEAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS

 - 5+ years in GTM engineering, revenue operations, sales operations, growth engineering, business systems, data engineering, internal tools, or another systems-building role close to revenue.

 - 3+ years directly owning CRM architecture, GTM automation, data pipelines, outbound infrastructure, attribution, or technically complex revenue programs.

 - Strong technical foundation: advanced SQL plus the ability to write and review production-quality Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript for integrations, automations, and internal tools.

 - Deep CRM fluency in HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, or similar, including objects, associations, account hierarchies, lifecycle stages, permissions, routing, reporting, deduplication, and data governance.

 - Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, ETL or reverse ETL, event instrumentation, identity resolution, error handling, observability, and modern data warehouses.

 - Practical fluency with modern GTM tools such as Clay, Apollo, Definitive Healthcare, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Salesloft, n8n, Make, Zapier, Workato, or equivalent platforms.

 - Production experience with LLM-powered research, extraction, classification, routing, or agentic automation, including structured outputs, evaluations, monitoring, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop review.

 - Strong analytical judgment across funnels, attribution, pipeline, conversion, velocity, cohort analysis, experimentation, and revenue impact.

 - Strong product sense and build-versus-buy judgment. You can turn a messy frontline problem into a coherent system that people trust and use.

 - Strong preference for experience in healthcare, provider partnerships, referrals, physician networks, field sales, multi-location organizations, or another complex relationship-driven business.

 - Healthcare and security judgment: disciplined access controls, auditability, minimum-necessary access and data use, consent, and close partnership with compliance and clinical leaders.

 - Bonus: experience with eFax, referral management, EHR integrations, HL7, FHIR, eligibility, claims, provider directories, or NPI data.

 - Excellent cross-functional communication. You can translate the needs of a sales representative, referral coordinator, operator, clinician, engineer, analyst, and executive into a system that works.

 - Low ego, high ownership, and startup intensity. You can diagnose the bottleneck, design the solution, ship a useful version, measure the result, and improve it quickly.




💰 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $140,000 – $260,000, based on experience

 - Early-Stage Equity: Meaningful ownership in a category-defining company.

 - Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

 - Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, GTM and revenue-systems tooling budget, learning stipend, AI tooling budget

 - Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

 - Work Hours: Flexible, with responsiveness around high-impact launches or system issues

 - Work Setup: In-Person in San Francisco, CA

 - Impact: Build the technical system that turns partnerships into faster access to high-quality medical care for all. 

 - Autonomy and Learning: Own CRM architecture, provider data, outbound infrastructure, referral workflows, attribution, AI automation, reporting, and partner-facing systems end-to-end.

  • Create account-scoring and territory systems that prioritize targets using geography, specialty, patient volume, payer mix, referral potential, network relationships, and engagement signals.

  • Build coordinated outbound workflows across email, phone, LinkedIn, direct mail, events, lunch-and-learns, and field sales using tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sequencing platforms, AI agents, and custom integrations.

  • Map clinic-level champions and referral coordinators alongside enterprise executives, clinical leaders, operations leaders, and centralized referral teams so Legion can sell from the bottom up and the top down.

  • Equip sales representatives with accurate contact data, office addresses, account briefs, relationship history, meeting preparation, follow-up automation, and clear next-best actions.

  • Deploy AI-assisted workflows for account research, stakeholder discovery, enrichment, outreach drafting, call intelligence, CRM updates, and follow-up with appropriate evaluations and human review.

  • Build an omnichannel referral-ingestion layer that turns fax, forms, APIs, tracked links, QR codes, phone calls, provider handoffs, and patients who begin online after a provider recommendation into structured, traceable records.

  • Automate referral processing, including document extraction, provider and organization matching, deduplication, completeness checks, routing, exception handling, and audit trails.

  • Connect referral intake to insurance eligibility and AI-native front-desk workflows for patient outreach, onboarding, and scheduling so referred patients reach the right next step without avoidable delays.

  • Own end-to-end attribution across the referring clinician, clinic, parent organization, partnership, sales representative, campaign, channel, UTM, QR code, landing page, fax source, and downstream patient journey.

  • Integrate the provider CRM, Legion’s database, the patient-facing CRM, PostHog, Braze or another lifecycle platform, analytics systems, and custom applications into one coherent data flow.

  • Partner with product and engineering to build secure provider-facing dashboards and workflows for referral volume, referral status, time-to-contact, scheduling progress, coverage and copay information, and other authorized care-coordination information.

  • Build compliant workflows that return medical records, care summaries, and status updates to referring care teams through approved fax, secure email, portal, interoperability, or other authorized channels at the right cadence.

  • Own production reliability across monitoring, logging, retries, rate-limit handling, identity resolution, testing, versioning, access control, documentation, and recovery when systems fail.

  • Treat HIPAA, PHI handling, minimum-necessary access, role-based permissions, audit trails, consent, and provider trust as product requirements in every automated workflow.

  • Make disciplined build-versus-buy decisions, ship useful first versions quickly, and drive adoption through clear playbooks, training, and change management.

  • Give Legion a provider CRM and data model that the team trusts as the source of truth.

  • Create a complete, prioritized map of each market so representatives spend time with the right organizations and people.

  • Build a repeatable outbound engine that produces qualified provider conversations and pipeline through coordinated digital, field, bottom-up, and top-down plays.

  • Ensure every referral is captured, processed, routed, and attributed correctly regardless of how it arrives.

  • Reduce the time from referral to eligibility, patient contact, onboarding, scheduling, and completed care.

  • Give referring care teams a secure, useful experience that increases trust and repeat referrals.

  • Remove repetitive research, data entry, document processing, routing, follow-up, and reporting work without sacrificing accuracy or judgment.

  • Build reliable systems that sales and operations adopt, improve continuously, and measurably increase referral volume, conversion, speed to care, partner retention, and revenue.

The CompanySoftdocs is a leading remote enterprise Software as a Service (SaaS) company specializing in serving Higher Education and K12 institutions, as well as State and Local Government through Etrieve, an enterprise content management (ECM) platform. With a remarkable 25-year history, Softdocs is committed to promoting educational and governmental equity by eliminating inefficiencies. Our core values of candor, collaboration, curiosity, grit, and inclusivity shape our approach to providing innovative solutions.

About the Role 

 

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to own the strategy, systems, integrations, and data infrastructure behind our go-to-market motion. You will sit within the marketing team working with our SDR function, marketing operations, and content teams to augment our marketing with highly scalable automated outbound activities. Your role is measured in quantity of leads and quality of subsequent pipeline. 

What You'll Do 

  • Use tools like Clay, Outreach, Apollo, Zapier and others to automate outbound efforts via email, LinkedIn, and other channels to augment and extend the efforts of our SDR team 

  • Use those same tools to identify and act upon web traffic, ad interactions, and third-party intent data to nurture leads into conversion; partner with performance marketing for tracking and ensure data integrity across the funnel 

  • Own the GTM marketing stack, including data integrity and integrations 

  • Build and maintain attribution models to track marketing performance across the funnel, from first touch to closed revenue 

  • Use Clay to build enrichment, scoring, and prospecting workflows 

  • Build dashboards and reporting to track campaign performance, pipeline contribution, and channel efficiency 

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive GTM processes using Zapier, native APIs, or custom scripts; suggest new tools to add or replace to keep the marketing tech stack current 

  • Document processes and workflows 

What We're Looking For 

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing and/or revenue operations, growth engineering, or a similar GTM systems role with evidence of pipeline growth success 

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce, including custom fields, workflows, and data architecture 

  • Experience with Clay for data enrichment and outbound workflow automation 

  • Experience with Outreach or a comparable sales engagement platform  

  • Familiarity with Zapier or similar iPaaS tools 

  • Ability to integrate AI tools into daily operations 

  • Strong understanding of marketing attribution models 

  • Comfort working with APIs, webhooks, and data mapping between systems 

  • Fluency with spreadsheets, SQL, or BI tools to validate data and report on performance 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience with SQL and/or a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Sigma, etc.) 

  • Familiarity with ad platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta) and conversion tracking setup 

  • Basic scripting ability (Python, JavaScript) for custom integrations beyond no-code tools 

  • Experience scaling a marketing tech stack at a high-growth startup 

 

What We Offer

  • Remote Position: 100% remote work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Direct Access to Leadership: You’ll have open access to our CEO and senior leaders from day one.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Disability, $15,000 Life Insurance, flexible PTO, 13 holidays, and paid parental leave.
  • Laptop/Equipment Stipend: Choose your laptop and set up your remote workspace your way.
  • Professional Development: Grow through training, learning opportunities, and leadership exposure.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration: Work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. Collaboration fuels innovation here.
  • People-First Culture: Bring your full self to work. We believe family time (however you define it) matters.
  • Retention Record: Our average employee tenure is over 5 years, with many team members here for more than a decade.
    • Softdocs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
